cases.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
cases.description: Individually design and implement production backend services and REST APIs in Python. Write, test, and review application code.

cases.title: Frontend Engineer
cases.description: Build browser user interfaces with TypeScript, CSS, and React. This role does not develop backend services or APIs.

cases.title: Cloud Platform Architect and DevOps Engineer
cases.description: Define the platform architecture and own its technical design. Build a Linux cloud platform with CI/CD pipelines, Terraform infrastructure as code, Kubernetes containers, and operational automation scripts.

cases.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Language Models
cases.description: Develop and deploy machine-learning systems for natural-language processing using large language models. Evaluate and improve generative AI inference pipelines.

cases.title: Data Pipeline Engineer
cases.description: Build batch and streaming data ingestion pipelines, warehouse transformations, and reliable data platforms. Data scientists consume the datasets, but this role does not create statistical models.

cases.title: Research Data Scientist
cases.description: Research statistical methods, design experiments, train predictive models, and communicate findings. Prototype machine-learning approaches rather than operate data pipelines.

cases.title: Cisco Network Security Engineer
cases.description: Configure and secure Cisco routers, switches, firewalls, and enterprise networks. Investigate network-security incidents and remediate vulnerabilities.

cases.title: Engineering Program Director
cases.description: Manage twelve engineers, hire and conduct performance reviews, own the program budget and integrated schedule, lead capture proposals, and coordinate customer commitments. No hands-on implementation is assigned.

cases.title: Technical Project Manager
cases.description: Plan and track a defined delivery project, maintain schedules and technical documentation, and present status directly to the customer. The position has no direct reports or hiring duties.

cases.title: Embedded Hardware Test Engineer
cases.description: Design embedded electronics and firmware interfaces, then perform hands-on validation with oscilloscopes in an engineering laboratory.

cases.title: Aircraft Maintenance Inspector
cases.description: Repair mechanical aircraft systems on the flight line and physically inspect completed maintenance for quality compliance.

cases.title: Laboratory Test Technician
cases.description: Set up laboratory test equipment, execute prescribed test procedures, record measurements, and maintain the lab. Engineering design is performed by another role.

cases.title: Production Fabrication Technician
cases.description: Machine and assemble metal components on a manufacturing floor, operate production equipment, and move kits and materials between warehouse staging areas.

cases.title: Remote Software Engineer
cases.description: This is a fully remote, work-from-home position with no routine office attendance. Travel to one annual team meeting may be required.

cases.title: Hybrid Customer Systems Engineer
cases.description: Work a hybrid schedule with three days each week at the customer site and two days remote. Travel about 25 percent to other customer offices.

cases.title: Classified Data Center Infrastructure Technician
cases.description: Work onsite in a classified data center. Install racks, pull network cabling, connect power, administer storage and virtualization hosts, and sustain the physical infrastructure.

cases.title: Deployed Field Service Engineer
cases.description: Deploy to outdoor customer locations for six-month assignments, relocate between sites, and perform field engineering repairs. Frequent travel and extended time away from home are mandatory.

cases.title: Shipboard Marine Technician
cases.description: Perform repairs aboard ships, including scuba work, entry into confined spaces, and work at heights. The job rotates 28 days onboard and 28 days off.

cases.title: Contracts Administrator
cases.description: The customer sells cloud, AI, Linux, networking, storage, and cybersecurity products. Those technologies are organizational context only; this role reviews contract terms and performs no engineering, administration, development, or technical operations.

cases.title: Windows Infrastructure Administrator
cases.description: Administer Windows Server, enterprise storage, and virtual machines. Maintain infrastructure availability and respond to operational incidents.

cases.title: International Site Lead
cases.description: Lead technical teams on rotating international assignments. Spend 60 percent of the year traveling outside the country at customer sites, with each rotation lasting eight weeks.
